options.name: addresses
options.description: The list of all addresses associated with the IPAM host, which may be in different IP spaces.

options.name: auto_generate_records
options.description: This flag specifies if resource records have to be auto generated for the host.

options.name: comment
options.description: The description for the IPAM host. May contain 0 to 1024 characters. Can include UTF-8.

options.name: host_names
options.description: The name records to be generated for the host. This field is required if I(auto_generate_records) is true.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the IPAM host. Must contain 1 to 256 characters. Can include UTF-8.

options.name: portal_key
options.description: The API token for authentication against Infoblox BloxOne API. If not set, the environment variable E(INFOBLOX_PORTAL_KEY) will be used.

options.name: portal_url
options.description: The Infoblox Cloud Services Portal (CSP) URL. If not set, the environment variable E(INFOBLOX_PORTAL_URL) will be used.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the object

options.name: tags
options.description: The tags for the IPAM host in JSON format.
